title: A framework for analyzing the proximate determinants of fertility
note: Population and Development Review 4(1):105-132. Registry seminal. Defines the proximate-determinants decomposition and the postpartum-infecundability index C_i that A.13 owns.

title: Fertility Biology and Behavior An Analysis of the Proximate Determinants
note: Academic Press. The book-length statement of the proximate-determinants model and the quantitative role of lactational infecundability. Expected to miss Crossref's article index.

crossref_best.matched_title: Fertility, Biology, and Behavior: An Analysis of the Proximate Determinants.

title: Contraceptive efficacy of lactational amenorrhoea
note: Lancet 339(8787):227-230. The prospective evidence behind the Bellagio consensus: amenorrheic, fully breastfeeding women <6 months postpartum have very low pregnancy risk — the amenorrhea-mechanism design that isolates A.13 from method adoption.

title: Nursing frequency gonadal function and birth spacing among !Kung hunter-gatherers
note: Science 207(4432):788-791. The classic natural-fertility anchor: frequent on-demand suckling sustains amenorrhea and long birth intervals absent contraception.

title: Fertility after childbirth: post-partum ovulation and menstruation in bottle and breast feeding mothers
note: Clinical Endocrinology 17(4):323-332. Establishes the suckling -> prolactin -> delayed ovulation/menstruation dose-response that is the physiological basis of the C_i effect.
